name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Infused RSO Dart | Northern Lights
description: Fresh Canna’s Northern Lights Live Resin Infused RSO delivers the timeless essence of a legendary indica. Known for its calming body effects and tranquil mind release, this blend combines the potency of full-spectrum RSO with the flavorful punch of live resin terpenes. Expect earthy pine notes balanced by a hint of sweetness, creating a deeply grounding experience perfect for evening use. Whether for relaxation, stress relief, or soothing the body, Northern Lights brings a classic, reliable calm in every dose.
